author: project team
base_recipe: gru_walkforward_20261010 control (= live ctrl5 recipe): 122 inputs, 4 heads, Gaussian-rank Pearson loss, 4 train slots, AdamW 3e-4, patience 8, 40 epochs, embargo 2 trading days

checkpoints.G0: C0 best15n vs C0 best (same training run)

early_stopping: unchanged for every arm: validation 14:00 y4 RankIC, patience 8

registered_comparisons.multiple_testing_note: 18 arm x checkpoint combinations; report all, Bonferroni-style caution in the write-up

winner_selection: Among G1a/G1b/G1c (primary checkpoint) choose the arm with the best T2024-window live-construction account replay (test year 2024); G2b/G4 judged against C0 only. 2025-2026 results confirm, never select.

evaluation.signal_chain: per-seed head4 zscore -> 5-seed mean -> production neutralize -> EMA 0.2 -> member zscore (gru_live_extend_20261012/signals_ext.py)
evaluation.construction: live construction: c5 blend 50/50, PCF skeleton, same-industry refill, beta tilt (P3), k=0.5, 10k CNY deadband, fees 2bp per side
comparisons: all15 vs all15 with cand5 replacing ctrl5
metrics: account active return vs C0, 20-day block bootstrap 2000 reps seed 20261011

go_live_gate.1: comparison object is the live construction
go_live_gate.2: >=4 of 5 seed pairs positive in 2025 and in 2026 separately
go_live_gate.3: 2025-01..2026-09 daily active-return difference: block-bootstrap mean >= +0.8 pp/yr and 90% lower bound >= -0.5 pp/yr
go_live_gate.4: CSI500 share of NAV, beta, max industry deviation, worst 20-day not worse; turnover increase <= 10%
go_live_gate.plus: shadow >= 5 trading days without faults, then explicit user approval; at most one change per week

falsification.G1: stop G2/G3 stacking if in T2025 and T2026 the live-construction b-weighted active return does not improve on >=4/5 seed pairs, or improvement only in 2024, or raw IC falls >20% with no account gain
falsification.G2b: not better than G1b on >=4/5 pairs, or higher volatility/size exposure of the final signal
falsification.G4: top-quantile return and account do not improve in >=2 of 3 windows (RankIC not used)
falsification.G6: any cut worse than A beyond seed noise, or majority of cuts not positive -> fall back to E (equal average of old and new) or no update

g6_finetune.data: last 60 trading days with all four labels matured before the 2-day embargo cut preceding the cut date
g6_finetune.evaluation: next 34 and 60 trading days; report distribution across cuts (positives, worst), not only the mean

not_in_this_wave: G3 turnover term (needs paired consecutive-day batches)
G7 minute expert (waits for Z3/Z4 gates)
